```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(stringr)
})

data_dir <- "data"
out_dir <- "results"
fig_dir <- "figures"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

sample_ids <- c("fVEH", "fTHC", "cVEH", "cTHC")

read_geo_matrix <- function(sample_id) {
  ReadMtx(
    mtx = file.path(data_dir, paste0(sample_id, "_matrix.mtx.gz")),
    cells = file.path(data_dir, paste0(sample_id, "_barcodes.tsv.gz")),
    features = file.path(data_dir, paste0(sample_id, "_features.tsv.gz")),
    feature.column = 2
  )
}
```

```{r}
objs <- lapply(sample_ids, function(sample_id) {
  mat <- read_geo_matrix(sample_id)

  x <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = mat,
    project = sample_id,
    min.cells = 3
  )

  x[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(x, pattern = "^mt-")
  x <- NormalizeData(x, verbose = FALSE)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

  subset(
    x,
    subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &
      nFeature_RNA < 7500 &
      percent.mt < 10
  )
})
names(objs) <- sample_ids
```

```{r}
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = objs, dims = 1:30)
obj <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, dims = 1:30)

obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000)
all_genes <- rownames(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = all_genes, assay = "RNA")
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = all_genes)
obj <- JoinLayers(obj, assay = "RNA", layers = c("counts", "data"))

obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj))
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:25)
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:25)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.6)

DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
```

```{r}
obj$SampleGroup <- dplyr::recode(
  obj$orig.ident,
  fVEH = "Femoral_VEH",
  fTHC = "Femoral_THC",
  cVEH = "Calvarial_VEH",
  cTHC = "Calvarial_THC"
)

obj$SampleGroup <- factor(
  obj$SampleGroup,
  levels = c("Femoral_VEH", "Femoral_THC", "Calvarial_VEH", "Calvarial_THC")
)

obj$tissue <- factor(
  ifelse(startsWith(obj$orig.ident, "f"), "Femoral", "Calvarial"),
  levels = c("Femoral", "Calvarial")
)

obj$condition <- factor(
  ifelse(endsWith(obj$orig.ident, "THC"), "THC", "VEH"),
  levels = c("VEH", "THC")
)

obj$stim_facet <- factor(
  gsub("_", "+", obj$SampleGroup),
  levels = c("Femoral+VEH", "Femoral+THC", "Calvarial+VEH", "Calvarial+THC")
)
```

```{r}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  obj,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.5,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
write.csv(markers, file.path(out_dir, "cluster_markers_RNA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
obj$cluster_number <- factor(
  obj$seurat_clusters,
  levels = names(cluster_ids)
)

number_colors <- setNames(cluster_colors[cluster_ids], names(cluster_ids))
number_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(names(cluster_ids), " : ", cluster_ids),
  names(cluster_ids)
)

p_umap <- DimPlot(
  obj,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "cluster_number",
  split.by = "SampleGroup",
  ncol = 4,
  label = TRUE,
  label.size = 5,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 1
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = number_colors,
    breaks = names(cluster_ids),
    labels = number_labels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), ncol = 1)) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

p_umap
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1A_UMAP.png"), p_umap, width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
composition <- tibble(
  Cluster = factor(obj$cell_type, levels = cluster_order),
  SampleGroup = obj$SampleGroup
) %>%
  count(Cluster, SampleGroup, name = "n") %>%
  complete(Cluster, SampleGroup, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(SampleGroup) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_composition <- ggplot(
  composition,
  aes(x = SampleGroup, y = percent, fill = Cluster)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of all cells", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

p_composition
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1B_composition.png"), p_composition, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
two_line_labels <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(label) {
    words <- str_split(label, "\\s+")[[1]]
    if (length(words) <= 1) return(label)
    split_at <- ceiling(length(words) / 2)
    paste(
      paste(words[seq_len(split_at)], collapse = " "),
      paste(words[(split_at + 1):length(words)], collapse = " "),
      sep = "\n"
    )
  }, character(1))
}

for (gene in c("Isg15", "Ifi27l2a", "Irf7")) {
  p <- VlnPlot(
    obj,
    features = gene,
    split.by = "SampleGroup",
    layer = "data"
  ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = two_line_labels(levels(Idents(obj)))) +
    guides(x = guide_axis(angle = 30)) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 22, 30)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("Figure5_", gene, "_violin.png")), p,
         width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```
